final_sql:
SELECT
  *
FROM ESTATES
WHERE
  property_type = 'Edifici adibiti ad albergo, pensione ed attività similari'
  AND surface_area >= 106.15
  AND HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) <= 5.0
  AND energy_class IN ('A1', 'A2', 'A3', 'A4', 'B', 'C', 'D')
  AND healthcare >= 50.53
ORDER BY
  HAVERSINE_KM(latitude, longitude, 45.0677551, 7.6824892) ASC

requirements.description: User wants the building preferably located near healthcare services (hospitals, pharmacies, clinics) for a residential senior care facility. Set at the 75th percentile (75.06, rounded to 75) of the healthcare distribution, which corresponds to the 'near' proximity threshold.

requirements.description: The user explicitly specified at least 1,600 sqm of gross floor area, so this is applied as a >= threshold on surface_area. The capacity of 30 people is not converted into an area filter because no verified gross-area threshold per occupant was supplied by the RegulatoryAgent. Energy class and proximity to healthcare services are outside the reference columns and are handled by other agents.

User prefers energy class D or better. Soft preference, so this is a ranking criterion and should not restrict the initial SQL filter. Area (>=1,600 sqm), capacity (30 people), Turin location and proximity to healthcare are outside the available columns and are not translated here.
